boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented UMass Lowell welcome, recognition, cultural and alumni traditions with direct institutional sources.

cards.title: New Student Convocation
cards.subtitle: Formal welcome to the River Hawk community
cards.notes: If you are new to UML, attend the formal welcome and notice how the ceremony introduces first-year and transfer students to campus.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding university welcome for incoming River Hawks.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell calls new student Convocation one of its oldest traditions and formally welcomes first-year and transfer students.
cards.source_title: Class of 2027 Welcomed to Campus at Annual Convocation Celebration
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of the academic-year opening; confirm the current year's event details with UMass Lowell.

cards.title: Close Convocation With “River Hawk Pride”
cards.subtitle: UMass Lowell’s fight song
cards.notes: Listen for the Marching Band’s performance of “River Hawk Pride” during Convocation, where the song is part of the formal program.
cards.short_summary: The fight song anchors the university’s new-student ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell identifies “River Hawk Pride” as its fight song and reports that the Marching Band performed it at Convocation.
cards.source_title: Class of 2027 Welcomed to Campus at Annual Convocation Celebration
cards.access_notes: Performed within Convocation programming; check the current Convocation schedule.

cards.title: The ROTC Color Presentation
cards.subtitle: A Convocation ceremony element
cards.notes: Arrive before the formal welcome begins to see the ROTC color presentation, a documented part of UMass Lowell’s Convocation program.
cards.short_summary: ROTC members present the colors during the campus welcome.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell reported that Air Force ROTC Detachment 345 presented the colors at its 2023 Convocation.
cards.source_title: Class of 2027 Welcomed to Campus at Annual Convocation Celebration
cards.access_notes: Part of Convocation programming; verify current ceremony details before attending.

cards.entity_name: UMass Lowell Marching Band at Convocation
cards.title: Marching Band Convocation Set
cards.subtitle: Live music for the new-student welcome
cards.notes: Make time for the band set at Convocation; the university documents its Marching Band as a recurring ceremonial presence there.
cards.short_summary: The UMass Lowell Marching Band helps stage the formal welcome.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell reported that its Marching Band performed at the 2023 Convocation, including the national anthem and fight song.
cards.source_title: Class of 2027 Welcomed to Campus at Annual Convocation Celebration
cards.access_notes: Part of Convocation programming; consult the current event listing for attendance details.

cards.title: Three Decades of Leadership Awards
cards.subtitle: Spring recognition banquet
cards.notes: Follow Student Life and Involvement for nominations and attend the spring banquet to recognize student organizations and individual leaders.
cards.short_summary: A spring awards tradition recognizing River Hawk leadership.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell describes the Student Leadership Awards as a three-decade tradition presented at an annual spring awards banquet.
cards.access_notes: Nominations and banquet details are administered by Student Life and Involvement.

cards.title: Asian Night
cards.subtitle: Spring cultural showcase by sister clubs
cards.notes: Watch for the spring program and support the student performers and cultural booths organized by UML’s Asian American sister clubs.
cards.short_summary: A recurring spring showcase of student-led cultural expression.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell identifies Asian Night as an annual March celebration hosted by a coalition of its student organizations.
cards.access_notes: Hosted in the middle of March according to UML; confirm the current event announcement.

cards.title: Night Market
cards.subtitle: Fall sister-club cultural celebration
cards.notes: Look for the fall Night Market and spend time with the student-run stalls, performances and participating cultural organizations.
cards.short_summary: A fall gathering built around student cultural organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell lists Night Market as a fall-semester event held by sister clubs supporting its Asian American Center.
cards.access_notes: UML places the event in mid-October; check current programming and any vendor pricing.

cards.entity_name: Walk a Mile in Her Shoes
cards.title: Walk a Mile in Her Shoes
cards.subtitle: Alpha Sigma Tau’s fall awareness march
cards.notes: Support the fall awareness event by learning from its anti-violence message and following the hosting chapter’s current participation guidance.
cards.short_summary: A chapter-organized annual march focused on ending domestic and sexual violence.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell states that Alpha Sigma Tau’s Beta Tau Chapter holds Walk a Mile in Her Shoes each fall as a men’s march to end domestic and sexual violence.
cards.access_notes: Event timing and participation details are set by the chapter and Fraternity and Sorority Life.

cards.title: River Hawk Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Annual alumni, family and campus celebration
cards.notes: Check the alumni calendar for Homecoming programming, then choose an all-ages event that fits your interests and access needs.
cards.short_summary: A recurring celebration connecting River Hawks across generations.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell invited alumni, family and friends to its 2025 Homecoming celebration commemorating the University of Lowell’s founding merger.
cards.source_title: Save the Date! Homecoming is October 18!
cards.access_notes: Annual programming varies; review the current Homecoming schedule and any registration requirements.

cards.title: The Offering’s Annual Issue
cards.subtitle: Student literary magazine published each spring
cards.notes: Submit eligible writing or visual art during the stated window, or pick up the April issue to see work from the UML community.
cards.short_summary: An annual print showcase for campus poetry, prose and visual art.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell’s English Department says its Literary Society publishes the annual campus literary magazine “The Offering,” appearing in print in April.
cards.access_notes: The department lists submissions generally from Nov. 1 to Feb. 15; verify current guidelines before submitting.
